biotools.summary: InterLabelGO+ is a hybrid protein function prediction tool that integrates deep learning and alignment-based methods, incorporating a novel loss function to address label dependency and imbalance. It achieved a strong performance in the CAFA5 challenge and is freely available on GitHub.
